clinical_intent: A 58-year-old woman named Linda has a 3 cm rectal cancer located 5 cm from the anal verge. She has completed neoadjuvant chemoradiation with 50.4 Gy and capecitabine. The restaging MRI shows a good response with the tumor downsized to 1.5 cm. The surgeon believes she may be a candidate for watch-and-wait management, but the radiation oncologist is recommending a brachytherapy boost. Analyze this clinical scenario and the decision-making process.
